item.title: Square White Background Sneaker

turns.text: Create one marketplace product photo of a white leather sneaker. Square image, plain white background, just the shoe.

item.tests: Delivers a text-generated marketplace image with the requested square framing and clean white background.

answer_sheet.Background and composition: Plain white background, just the shoe.

must_haves: Exactly one white leather sneaker is shown.
The background is plain white, with no scenery or props.
The entire shoe is visible with space around it.
No promotional text, badges or graphic borders appear.

turns.text: Could you create one marketplace product photo for me? I’m trying to get a listing ready and have probably spent too long thinking about the picture. The product is a white leather sneaker, and the image should be square. I just worry about whether the photo will look right for the listing. Please use a plain white background and show just the shoe.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make the photo. Your Magic Hour account turned down the request because it doesn't have enough credits. Nothing was created, so there's no download link.

I asked for a single square 640px image using flux-2-klein, which is one of the cheapest models on the free plan (from 5 credits per image). The other free image models cost the same or more, so trying them would fail the same way. Once you add credits or your balance refreshes, I can run the same request again.

**Here's the request I'd send:**
> Professional product photo of one clean white leather sneaker, angled three-quarter side view, centred on a plain white background, soft even studio lighting, a faint natural shadow under the shoe, sharp focus on the leather and stitching, nothing else in the frame (no text, logos or props).

**About your worry over whether the photo will look right:** a shot like that fits most marketplace rules for a main image.
- **Plain white background:** many marketplaces require this.
- **Just the product:** many marketplaces also require this.
- **Square:** shows up well in search results.
- **Three-quarter angle:** shows both the side and the toe, which is how buyers usually judge sneakers.

One thing to keep in mind: an AI-generated image shows *a* white sneaker, not your exact pair. Many marketplaces want photos of the actual item, especially for used shoes. If you have a photo of your own shoe, attach it once you have credits. I can remove the background and put it on clean white for 5 credits. That's usually the safer choice for a listing.
